title: For 2 days, a lifetime subscription to this popular ad blocker is just $11
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Block ads and trackers on up to nine devices with a lifetime AdGuard Family Plan, just $11 (reg. $169.99) through October 4.

Banner ads, pop-ups, and autoplay videos clutter pages on your Mac and iPhone, and plenty of them track what you do along the way. AdGuard blocks those ads and trackers across your whole household, and a lifetime subscription is on sale for $11 (reg. $169.99).

Once AdGuard is running, banners, pop-ups, and video ads disappear from the pages you visit. Trackers and activity analyzers get blocked too, so your browsing data stays hidden from them. AdGuard also blocks malware and phishing websites to keep your devices safer.

Parents can turn on parental controls to restrict adult and inappropriate content on their kids’ devices. One Family Plan works on up to nine devices at once, including Macs on macOS 10.15 or newer and iPhones on iOS 12 or newer. Windows PCs and Android phones running Android 7 or newer work with it as well.

Stop sitting through ads on every device in your house.

Get the AdGuard Family lifetime subscription on sale for $11 (reg. $169.99).

Sale ends October 4 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
